keyword: what time does the masters end
claims: The 2026 Masters final round is expected to conclude on Sunday, April 12, between 6:00 p.m. and 7:00 p.m. ET.
2026 Masters final round coverage airs on CBS and Paramount+ from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
The Green Jacket Ceremony immediately follows the conclusion of the 2026 Masters final round play.
2026 Masters final round coverage is available on CBS, Paramount+, Masters.com, and the Masters App.
If a playoff is required, the 2026 Masters will extend past 7:00 p.m. ET
